think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel numeric values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special-case) rather than just scaling up/down. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
